title: How does Pinnacle Blooms Network ensure parents’ involvement in their child's therapy process?
metaTitle: Parent Involvement in Child's Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network ensures parent involvement in their child's therapy process. Learn about the communication methods and support programs for parents.
html: Communication between therapists and parents is a key part of our approach. Regular updates, parent education sessions, workshops, and home program training are some ways we ensure parents’ involvement.
